Position: Angular Developer

Position Summary
We are seeking a skilled Angular Developer to join MeridianSoft Technologies, a mid-sized enterprise software company delivering cloud-enabled B2B solutions for finance and operations. The Angular Developer will work on a product team responsible for a next-generation customer portal used by large institutional clients. The role requires hands-on front-end development, strong collaboration with UX and backend teams, and a focus on maintainable, testable code. This is an on-site position in Pune with a hands-on engineering cadence; remote work is not available.

Key Responsibilities

Feature Development and Implementation
- Design, develop and maintain responsive user interfaces using Angular and TypeScript.
- Implement UI components, pages and route-driven interactions consistent with product requirements and accessibility guidelines.
- Translate UX designs and wireframes into high-quality code and reusable component libraries.

Testing, Quality and Automation
- Write and maintain unit and integration tests using Jest to ensure component reliability and correctness.
- Work with QA to define acceptance criteria and implement test automation where applicable.
- Participate in code reviews and enforce front-end best practices and coding standards.

Styling and Cross-Browser Compatibility
- Implement CSS for layout, theming and responsive behavior across desktop and tablet form factors.
- Troubleshoot and resolve cross-browser UI issues and performance bottlenecks.

Collaboration and Agile Delivery
- Collaborate with product owners, UX designers and backend engineers to refine requirements and deliver incremental value in Agile sprints.
- Estimate tasks, participate in daily standups and contribute to sprint planning, retrospectives and backlog grooming.
- Document component APIs, design decisions and integration contracts with REST/GraphQL services.

Maintenance and Technical Debt Management
- Identify and remediate technical debt in the front-end codebase to improve maintainability and reduce bugs.
- Assist in migrating legacy views to modern Angular patterns and modular architecture.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 3+ years of professional experience building web applications with modern front-end frameworks.

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- Angular
- Jest
- TypeScript
- CSS

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Experience with NgRx for state management
- Familiarity with Cypress for end-to-end testing
- Strong knowledge of HTML and semantic markup
- Experience with RxJS patterns for reactive programming

Success Metrics
- Timely delivery of assigned features with demonstrated adherence to acceptance criteria and quality gates.
- High unit test coverage for new components and reductions in production bugs related to UI after deployment.
- Reusable component library adoption rate across product teams and documented APIs for at least 80% of new components.
- Measurable improvements in page load and render performance for targeted portal pages (e.g., 20% reduction in Time to Interactive).
- Positive feedback from product and UX stakeholders on visual fidelity and accessibility compliance.

Location and Work Mode
Pune, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
